high.title: Q1 2026 Financial Results Update April 28: 16 Companies Report Trillion VND Profits, Banking Sector Dominates, Retail Shows High Growth
high.summary: Vietnam's corporate earnings for Q1 2026 show strong performance in the banking sector, which is crucial for VND stability and monetary policy transmission. 16 companies reported profits exceeding VND 1 trillion, with 7 being banks led by Techcombank (TCB) at VND 8.87 trillion and BIDV at VND 8.572 trillion. Banking sector maintained steady growth with increases of 16-58%, with VPBank and Techcombank showing strong momentum while LPBank and Saigonbank were among the few with negative growth. This banking sector strength supports VND stability by maintaining confidence in the financial system. The securities sector also performed well with SSI, VPS, and TCBS all reporting trillion-VND profits and double-digit growth, though smaller firms struggled. Strong banking earnings typically correlate with stable credit conditions and support for economic growth, which is positive for currency stability and may influence SBV's monetary policy stance.

high.title: Q1 2026 Results Update for 14 Banks: A Bank Reports 268% Profit Growth
high.summary: ABBank reported exceptional standalone profit growth of 268% in Q1 2026 to VND 1.5 trillion, the highest growth recorded to date. This dramatic improvement in banking profitability signals strong credit demand and effective risk management, which supports VND stability through financial sector confidence. BIDV reported consolidated pre-tax profit of VND 8.571 trillion, up 16% year-over-year, with total assets growing 1.7% to VND 3.388 quadrillion. Customer loans increased 2.4% to over VND 2.4 quadrillion while deposits fell 3.6%, but certificate of deposit issuance surged 48.6% to over VND 228 trillion. This shift in funding structure suggests banks are adapting to changing liquidity conditions and may indicate rising funding costs, which could influence SBV monetary policy decisions and VND/USD dynamics through interest rate differentials.

high.title: State Bank of Vietnam Issues Important Warning Related to Biometric Data
high.summary: The State Bank of Vietnam issued urgent directives to credit institutions regarding cybersecurity threats involving fraudulent use of customers' biometric data to open virtual bank accounts for money laundering and fraud. SBV requires banks to regularly review and upgrade IT infrastructure, particularly integrating AI/deepfake detection solutions for Mobile Banking and Online Banking authentication processes. Banks must implement stricter identity verification for first-time or new device logins and actively monitor transactions with early warning systems for suspicious activities. This regulatory focus on financial system security is crucial for maintaining confidence in Vietnamese banking infrastructure, which supports VND stability and digital payment adoption. Enhanced cybersecurity measures may require additional compliance costs for banks but strengthen overall financial system resilience, supporting long-term monetary policy effectiveness and cross-border payment system integrity.

medium.title: Expert: Don't Look at Indices to Buy, These are 4 Stock Groups with Opportunity to "Follow Vingroup's Wave"
medium.summary: Vietnam's stock market is entering a sensitive phase with VN-Index held high by large-cap stocks while money flow remains concentrated and hasn't spread evenly. Market expert from Kafi Securities notes that while deep correction risk isn't high, short-term volatility pressure is unavoidable, with VN-Index gains primarily driven by Vingroup while many other stocks remain in consolidation.

medium.title: Banks Continue Strong Capital Injection into Real Estate Business: Growth 8 Times Faster Than Average, Bank Leaders Say This Sector Still Has Much Potential
medium.summary: Credit to real estate business reached over VND 2.2 quadrillion by February 28, 2026, up 11.7% from Q4 2025 and 43% year-over-year. This represents growth 8 times faster than the economy-wide credit growth of 1.4%, indicating strong capital flow concentration into property sector which could impact overall monetary policy transmission.

medium.title: Securities Companies Earn Nearly VND 10,000 Billion Pre-tax Profit in First Quarter: "Throne" Changes Hands, One Name Loses Nearly 60% Profit
medium.summary: Securities sector's total pre-tax profit reached about VND 9.7 trillion in Q1 2026, up 26% year-over-year but down 19% from Q4 2025, marking the second consecutive quarter of declining profits from the record VND 19 trillion peak in Q3 2025, reflecting market cooling after previous highs.

medium.title: Expert Warns Stock Market Usually Has 2 Major Decline Waves Each Year: Will Old Scenario Repeat?
medium.summary: Market faces complex macro variables from global oil prices and internal pressure as VN-Index heavily depends on single stock groups amid peak margin debt. Rising oil prices above $105/barrel due to Hormuz tensions create direct pressure on Vietnamese and international markets, potentially pushing 2026 inflation to 4-4.5% range, narrowing monetary policy room.

medium.title: Gold Ring and Bar Prices on April 27
medium.summary: International gold prices fell 0.25% to $4,696/ounce due to stronger USD pressure, while oil price increases raise inflation concerns and prospects for prolonged high interest rates as US-Iran peace negotiations remain deadlocked.

medium.title: Evening April 28, Gold Prices Drop Sharply
medium.summary: International gold prices fell over 2% to $4,585/ounce to three-week lows as oil prices rose due to stalled US-Iran negotiations, raising inflation concerns and interest rate fears ahead of central bank decisions.
